_readme: MEASURED 2026-09-06 against real 720x1600 captures: the preserved I&J Blockbusters and Brito's states in public/ccv2/shots, plus current-app Bakery Demo Beat 04 states in public/ccv-refresh/hunt/bakery-demo.

Each box = the target's pixel bounds plus a 10px margin, normalized 0..1 of the FULL still including the 120px status bar. color = sky | skyDeep | emerald | amber | coral. Re-measure: nx = px/720, ny = px/1600.
